patches.title: Bound tiffcrop's debug sample dump loop
patches.description: Bounds the debug output loop to the MAX_SAMPLES capacity of srcbuffs.

dep3.origin: Backport of upstream commit 88cf9db, adapted for Ubuntu Focal's tiffcrop source.

tests.baselineExpectation: The exact installed baseline tiffcrop terminates with SIGSEGV while running the level-2 text debug dump on the nine-sample planar fixture; source-build AddressSanitizer evidence identifies the affected sample-buffer overflow.
tests.patchedExpectation: The installed patched tiffcrop completes the same debug dump and tiffinfo can read the output.
